args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion on the Coastal team:

- Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026.
- "PHL" is also shorthand for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering "PHL" in the morning report returns both businesses.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label made the receiving supervisor search twice.
- Suggested fix: rename that saved report to "Pellow Home Living — Late Arrivals", and use the full business names instead of "PHL" in saved views and exports.

Thanks,
Bettina
